verses.verse:
आयासस्तु विशेषः स्यात् सप्तकात् सप्तकेऽपरे।
गच्छताम् साधकानां हि तत्पृथक् साध्यताम् मुहुः।९१।
verses.text: There is special effort for practitioners going from one octave to another; so that should be practised separately, again and again.

commentary.text: That is, after opening all the holes, closing them all at once makes the next note come out as 'Sa' of the second octave. To make this difficulty easy, one should raise and lower five fingers from the top together, again and again. Making the procedure of ārohāvaroha (ascent and descent) on the bānsurī still clearer —

subsection.title: Practice of the Tongue and of the Fingers
